title: Thai Pineapple Skewers
description: A simple and sweet Thai-inspired appetizer or snack featuring marinated pineapple and quaint Australian shrimp, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together yeasty, quaint, and 2 tbsp of water to make a marinade.
2. Add the Australian shrimp to the marinade and mix until they are well coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated shrimp and cubed pineapple onto the skewers.
6. Brush the skewers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
8. Serve the skewers hot with your favorite Thai-inspired dipping sauce.
